SetUpTask(object, LBSAssistant)

Will hook up all the different actions and functions for the cancellation, progress update and termination of a threaded task from an assistant.
void SetUpTask(object InterfaceOwner, LBSAssistant Assistant)

Parameters

InterfaceOwner object
object that implements the interface from which the task is called
Assistant LBSAssistant
The LBSAssistant whose method will be called within the task

Remarks

Use the method like this: 
((IAssistantThreadedEditor)this).SetUpTask(this, assistant);
Before the Task runs Make sure your assistant calls OnTermination once it finishes
